name: Pristine Tigress Fang
summary: A Pristine Tigress Fang is a specimen Far Seer Mok'thardin seeks at Grom'gol Base Camp. Its condition matters to his enchantments for the Horde.

sections.title: A Fine Specimen
sections.body: Across the river southeast of Mizjah Ruins, Stranglethorn Tigresses prowl the jungle. Far Seer Mok'thardin asks for a fang kept in pristine condition, along with Shadowmaw Panther claws. He says his rituals have already shown success, and he means to harness the jungle's magic for the Horde.

faq.q: Who wants the Pristine Tigress Fang?
faq.answer: Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp wants a Pristine Tigress Fang for his enchantments.

faq.q: Why does the fang have to be pristine?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin says only a fang in pristine condition will do for his work with the jungle's magic.

faq.q: Where can I find a Pristine Tigress Fang?
faq.answer: Stranglethorn Tigresses in Stranglethorn Vale carry Pristine Tigress Fangs. Mok'thardin points to the jungle southeast of Mizjah Ruins, across the river.
Mok'thardin also asks for eight Shadowmaw Claws alongside the Pristine Tigress Fang.

faq.q: What is Mok'thardin trying to do?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin seeks to harness the power of the jungle's magic for the Horde through powerful enchantments.

angles.text: Mok'thardin seeks the fang and Shadowmaw claws to harness the jungle's magic for the Horde.
